description: Election Commission -  Declare that N. A. M. Asam as a  member of the Kalumunai Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Kalmunai Municipal Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for a local authority, including the resignation of a member and the subsequent nomination and declaration of a new member by the Returning Officer. This falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category, which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authorities.
